title: Effect of catholyte in a single step electrochemical hydroiodic acid decomposition for hydrogen production using the iodine–sulfur thermochemical cycle
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39937-39953
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07522F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ashwin Yashawanth Hegde, Saroj Chaudhary, Parvatalu Damaraju, Pradeep Kumar Sow
This study identifies the most suitable catholyte for the electrochemical HI decomposition process, an emerging single-step alternative to the conventional multistep iodine section of the I–S thermochemical cycle for hydrogen production.
